result_text:
The stock list of a warehouse now leaves out products with zero quantity. I made a one-line change to `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (line 1491): the query gets `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same condition the other stock overviews use.

The per-product quantity lookup is a separate method, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. I did not add a test for the example case. The 38 existing stock-related tests pass offline (`mvn -o test -Dtest='*Stock*Test'`). No test calls `listStockByWarehouse` directly, so the new filter is not covered by a test. Nothing is committed.
